title: Accounts Assistant
company: Recruitment Solutions (North West) Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
An exciting opportunity to join a growing and supportive finance team as an Accounts Assistant. This is a varied role ideal for someone with previous finance or accounts experience who is looking to develop their skills within a busy and professional environment.

What You'll Be Doing:
- Assisting with day-to-day finance and accounts activities.
- Processing purchase and sales invoices accurately and efficiently.
- Assisting with purchase and sales ledger activities.
- Processing payments and updating financial records.
- Completing bank reconciliations and investigating any discrepancies.
- Supporting with month-end processes and general finance administration.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring information is entered in a timely manner.
- Assisting with the preparation and organisation of financial information.
- Using accounting systems and Excel to process, analyse and maintain financial data.
- Providing general support to the wider finance and accounts team.

What We're Looking For:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or similar finance role.
- A good understanding of general accounting and finance processes.
- Good working knowledge of Excel and accounting systems.
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Good organisational and time management skills.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively as part of a team.
- A positive and professional approach with a willingness to learn and develop.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator

Up to £15.44 per hour, depending on experience Full time, permanent Flexible part time considered

We're recruiting a Payroll Administrator for an established business looking for someone organised, accurate and confident handling confidential information.

The role is available full time. Part time applicants will also be considered if they can offer flexibility around payroll deadlines, as the key processing days vary from month to month.

The role

You'll help deliver an accurate, timely payroll and be a helpful point of contact for employee queries. Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing payroll to agreed deadlines
- Entering and checking starters, leavers, pay changes, overtime, deductions and absences
- Maintaining accurate employee and payroll records
- Using Ceequel and Payroll Opera to manage payroll information
- Preparing and updating payroll spreadsheets in Excel
- Checking and reconciling payroll data, and resolving discrepancies
- Responding clearly and professionally to payroll queries
- Preparing payroll reports and supporting related administration

About you

You'll have previous payroll administration experience, strong attention to detail and the ability to work calmly to deadlines. You should be comfortable using Excel and handling sensitive employee information with discretion.

Experience with Ceequel or Payroll Opera would be an advantage. You'll also need to be approachable, dependable and willing to work with colleagues to resolve queries promptly.

Pay: Up to £15.44 per hour, depending on experience and agreed hours.

If you're looking for a payroll role where accuracy and reliability are valued, we'd like to hear from you. Please apply with your CV and let us know whether you're seeking full time or flexible part time hours.

title: Claims Handler - Household
company: Red Dot Search UK Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Household Claims Handler Bolton £26,000 - £28,000 Mon-Fri, 9-5

Experienced in household claims and want your own caseload rather than a script and a queue?

We're recruiting a Household Claims Handler for a well-established general insurer just outside Bolton. You'll own household and property claims end to end - first notification through to settlement - with the authority to validate, negotiate and settle within your limits.

This is a household claims handler role for someone who already knows the work. If you've spent 12 months or more in household or property claims and you're ready to take full ownership of a caseload, this is a straight step up in autonomy and salary.

What you'll be doing
- Managing a varied caseload of domestic property claims from first notification to final settlement
- Handling FNOL calls and correspondence, confirming valid grounds to claim
- Assessing policy cover, benefits and liability against guidelines
- Validating and negotiating settlements within your authority
- Appointing and managing suppliers supporting the policyholder
- Identifying and referring suspicious underwriting or potential fraud
- Keeping policyholders updated clearly throughout the claim
- Managing your own diary and prioritising a busy caseload

What you'll need
- Minimum 12 months in a household or property claims role
- Confident telephone manner and genuine listening skills
- High attention to detail - accuracy matters here
- Comfortable moving between multiple systems
- GCSE English and Maths at Grade C/4 or above
- Holding or willing to work towards the CII Certificate (fully supported and funded)

What's on offer
- £26,000 - £28,000 depending on experience
- 35-hour week, Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm - no evenings, no weekends
- On site in Bolton with free on-site parking
- Full support and funding towards CII qualifications
- Holiday allowance that increases with length of service, plus a holiday sell scheme
- Your birthday off, and a half-day for seasonal shopping
- Contributory pension, cycle to work scheme, discounted sports and social
- Cash bonus for going above and beyond
- Casual dress, free branded clothing
- Trained mental health and first-aid staff on site

The honest bit

It's an on-site role in Bolton, five days a week. There's no hybrid on this one. If you want office-based work with sociable hours, a real caseload and a company that pays for your qualifications, it's a good seat. If you're after remote or compressed hours, this isn't the one.

Apply now and we'll come back to you to talk it through properly - including who the employer is, what the team looks like, and what the first six months actually involve.

title: Claims Handler - Third Party Motor
company: Red Dot Search UK Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Third Party Claims Handler - Motor & Credit Hire Bolton £27,000 - £30,000 Full or part-time

Know your way around third party motor claims and credit hire, and want the complex files rather than the easy ones?

We're recruiting an experienced Third Party Claims Handler for an established general insurer just outside Bolton. You'll handle third party vehicle and property damage claims end to end - investigation, liability, negotiation, resolution - including the disputed liability files and the credit hire challenges that need someone who actually knows the arguments.

This is a third party claims handler role with real technical weight. If you've got two years or more in motor claims or credit hire and you're tired of being handed only the straightforward files, this is the one.

What you'll be doing
- Managing all aspects of third party claims: investigation, negotiation and resolution
- Investigating liability, working with other departments and running your own enquiries
- Handling more advanced cases - high-value claims and disputed liability files
- Assessing and managing credit hire: validation, negotiation, and challenging excessive hire charges
- Liaising with solicitors, insurers and accident management companies
- Recognising and escalating potentially fraudulent activity
- Prioritising your own caseload and supporting wider team duties
- Maintaining a high standard of service with every party to the claim

What you'll need
- Minimum 2 years' motor claims experience to be considered at the upper end of the range
- Third party or credit hire experience - the more disputed-liability work, the better
- Confident dealing with solicitors and accident management companies
- High attention to detail and sound judgement on liability
- Comfortable across multiple systems
- GCSE English and Maths at Grade C/4 or above
- Holding or willing to work towards the CII Certificate (fully supported and funded)

What's on offer
- £27,000 - £30,000 depending on experience
- 35-hour week, Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm - and genuinely flexible working patterns
- Full-time or part-time considered
- On site in Bolton with free on-site parking (hybrid options)
- Full support and funding towards CII qualifications
- Holiday allowance that increases with length of service, plus a holiday sell scheme
- Your birthday off, and a half-day for seasonal shopping
- Contributory pension, cycle to work scheme, discounted sports and social
- Cash bonus for going above and beyond
- Casual dress, free branded clothing
- Trained mental health and first-aid staff on site

The honest bit

It's an on-site (poss hybrid) role in Bolton - the flexibility here is in the working pattern, not the location. The upside is the work itself: this employer is growing through new contracts and internal promotions, so the complex files and the progression are both real. If you want disputed liability and credit hire rather than a volume FNOL queue, this is a good seat.

Apply now and we'll come back to you to talk it through properly - including who the employer is, the team structure, and what flexibility is genuinely on the table.

title: Call Centre Operator - Uncapped Commission
description:
Start Date: 02/11/2026

Full Time Role - 37.5 hours per week

Stanford House Birchwood WA3 7 TH

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Warrington is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Warrington contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE
- GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.
- UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.
- BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.
- GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.
- FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.
- GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking an experienced receptionist to join our friendly team In Bolton. As a member of frontline staff you will be the first point of contact for our service users and visitors. You will need to be non-judgemental with excellent communication and listening skills. Experience of working in General Practice is desirable. You will be working collaboratively and across sites where required with Bolton Medical Centre, Bolton General Practice, Shanti Medical Centre & 3D Medical Centre You must be able to deal objectively and professionally in a calm and approachable manner when liaising with patients, staff, healthcare professionals and outside agencies. Prioritising a busy workload, being a good team player and possessing the ability to deal with a wide range of clerical and administration duties in a busy environment is also required. Knowledge of the EMIS web system would be an advantage; full training and support would be offered to the successful applicant.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: Hours for this post are 18 hours per week working Monday 8:00am -13:00pm, Wednesday 08:00am-12:00pm,Thursday 8:00am-13:00pm, Friday 8:00am-12:00pm Role To assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. To provide comprehensive general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone. To ensure that the working environment is kept tidy and fully operational, Health & Safety compliant and that standards and high attention to detail levels are maintained at all times. Duties may be varied from time to time under the direction of the Management Team, dependent on current and evolving Practice workload and staffing levels: Receiving patients attending for appointments with members of practice team Handing completed repeat prescriptions to patients and checking names and addresses Be able to cover all other reception duties as necessary Process immediate (and emergency) appointment requests and requests for future appointments from patients by telephone and in person Deal with requests for home visits Answer telephone and deal with all queries resulting from that call. Navigating patients to the most appropriate clinician and care required. Advising patients of the relevant charges for private services, accepting all types of payments and issuing receipts where necessary. Delivering assistance to clinicial staff when needed i.e. chaperoning (after revelant training). Dealing with first hand verbal complaints, if not resolved then directed to the complaints team Have working knowledge of telephone system, during and after hours. Key Responsibilities Administration To have a thorough knowledge of all Practice procedures. To work in accordance of written protocols Filing post in medical records electronically or hard copy as appropriate Scan and photocopy documents as requested Open, sort and distribute incoming mail to appropriate members of the practice or other organisations as appropriate Registration of new patients computer data entry and medical records Deducting patients as appropriate. Process patients change of address computer data and medical records (have knowledge of practice area. Process repeat prescription requests in accordance with practice guidelines Process outgoing mail ensuring correct packaging, format and postage to reach destination Assist Secretaries and Practice Management with ad-hoc administration tasks as required Reception Have working knowledge of telephone system, during and after hours Other Tasks Opening up/locking up of Practice premises and maintaining security in accordance with Practice protocols. Prepare/restock and clear rooms before/after surgeries Assist with the collection of clinical waste. Providing refreshments for staff and visitors as required, and keeping the kitchen clean and tidy Any other tasks allocated by managers and/or appropriate to the grade Liaison with secondary care (after appropriate training) Ensure clinical rooms secure at end of each day with systems appropriately closed down. Other Job Responsibilities Confidentiality Maintain confidentiality of information, acting within the terms of the Data Protection Act 2018, with specific reference to the General Data Protection Regulations (GDPR) and Caldicott guidance on patient confidentiality at all times Maintain an awareness of the Freedom of Information Act Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the Practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data.

title: GP Receptionist / Administrator
description: We are looking to appoint a Receptionist/Administrator to join our GP practice team. You will be the first point of contact for patients, liaising with clinical and admin staff together with patients, as well as carrying out general office management tasks. You will have a good telephone manner and organisational skills. The successful person will be required to be flexible with hours between 07:45 and 18:30 Monday to Friday. Previous work in a similar role is preferred. Answering medication queries from patients, staff, pharmacies and care homes. Process prescriptions Forward medication related queries to an appropriate Health Care Professional in a timely manner Check tasks regularly and action appropriately Review clinical letters and workflow as appropriate Welcome patients warmly and provide exceptional customer service. Handle incoming calls efficiently and direct them appropriately. Schedule appointments, manage patient registrations, and process medical forms. Maintain accurate patient records and ensure data confidentiality. Assist with administrative tasks Contribute to a positive and supportive team environment. Processing prescriptions, letters, referrals, and clinical documents. Ensuring confidentiality and professionalism in all aspects of the role. SystmOne Tasks Handling emails Act as a chaperone Process incoming and outgoing correspondence, including managing workflow tasks Manage all queries (including administrative queries) as necessary in an efficient manner Input data into the patient's healthcare records as necessary Support the team in the effective use of searches, audits and recalls Direct requests for information, i.e. SAR, insurance / solicitors letters and DVLA forms to the administrative team. We are looking to appoint a Receptionist to join our busy GP practices. HOURS:Monday 08:00 - 18:30Tuesday 12:30 - 18:30Friday 07:45 - 18:00 You will liaise with clinical and admin staff together with patients, as well as carrying out general office management tasks. You will have a good telephone manner and experience of booking appointments proving strong organisational skills. You will manage general administrative duties within the practices and work with our established processes, policies and procedures to provide a comprehensive high quality service and deal efficiently and courteously with patient enquiries and bookings. You will have excellent communication skills, a compassionate and friendly nature who can operate in a busy, demanding environment with a range of people and professions. Your regular duties in this role will be dealing with telephone, face to face and electronic enquiries, booking and/or amending patient appointments and home visits, contacting patients to provide information from the clinical team and assisting patients to access our services and those available in the wider community. IT skills are essential, as you will be expected to work on the clinical system - SystmOne - and manage incoming emails Other Job Responsibilities CONFIDENTIALITY Maintain confidentiality of information, acting within the terms of the Data Protection Act and Caldicott guidance on patient confidentiality at all times. Maintain an awareness of the Freedom of Information Act. Comply with Practice health & safety policies by following agreed safe working procedures Actively report health & safety hazards and infection hazards immediately Keeping work and general areas clean and tidy, and using appropriate infection control procedures to keep work areas hygienic and safe from contamination. Awareness and compliance with national standards of infection control, hygiene, regulatory / contractual / professional requirements, and good practice guidelines. Correct personal use of Personal Protective Equipment PPE and ensuring correct use of PPE by others, advising on appropriate circumstances for use by clinicians, staff and patients. Reporting incidents using the organisations Incident Reporting System Using personal security systems within the workplace according to Practice guidelines Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills Demonstrate safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and adults at risk. EQUALITY AND DIVERSITY The post-holder will support, promote and maintain the Practices Equality & Diversity Policy. No person whether they are staff, patient or visitor should receive less favourable treatment because of their gender, ethnic origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion etc. The jobholder must comply with all policies and procedures designed to ensure equality of employment and that services are delivered in ways that meet the individual needs of patients and their families. OTHER DELEGATED DUTIES This job description is not intended to be exhaustive - it may be changed after consultation with the post holder. The employee shares with the employer the responsibility for review and modification of duties.
